capabilities.title: Built for the meeting where the number gets questioned
capabilities.movementBody: A total tells you where you landed. Cadence shows the four forces that got you there, each one traceable down to the subscription that moved.
capabilities.invoicesBody: Every figure ties back to a settled invoice. When finance and growth disagree about MRR, there is a row to point at.
capabilities.cohortBody: Watch each signup cohort hold or decay month over month, so a good quarter for acquisition never hides a bad one for retention.
capabilities.alertsBody: A failed payment on a $6,000 account and one on a $12 trial are not the same event. Cadence tells them apart before it tells you.

how.title: Three steps, in this order
how.step1Body: Point Cadence at Stripe, Chargebee, or your own subscriptions table. Historical invoices backfill in minutes.
how.step2Body: Decide what counts as expansion, when a trial becomes revenue, and how to treat annual prepayment. Cadence holds those rules for everyone.
how.step3Body: Finance, growth and the board read from one dashboard. Month-end becomes a review, not a reconciliation.

faq.title: Before you start
faq.q1: Does Cadence replace our accounting system?
faq.a1: No. Cadence reads from billing and reports on recurring revenue. Your ledger stays where it is — Cadence just stops the two from disagreeing.
faq.a2: Connecting a billing provider takes a few minutes and backfill runs on historical invoices. Agreeing your revenue definitions is the part that takes a conversation, and it is the part worth spending time on.
faq.q3: What counts as expansion versus new business?
faq.a3: You decide, once. Seat increases, plan upgrades and add-on purchases can each be classified as expansion or as new business, and the choice applies everywhere so two reports never disagree.
faq.a4: Every view exports to CSV, and the API returns the same figures the dashboard shows. Nothing is trapped behind the interface.
faq.a5: Fourteen days on the Growth plan, no card required. If your billing data is not connected by the end of it, the trial extends.
